VEHICLE CARE PROGRAM (VCP) AGREEMENT
This agreement describes the
Services
You
will have under
Your
Vehicle Care Program (VCP) Agreement (hereafter referred to as “Agreement”). In return for payment
by
You
of the
Agreement Price
and subject to all terms of this Agreement,
We
agree with
You
as follows:
I. KEY TERMS
When used in the Agreement, Key Terms will appear in
bold
print and initial uppercase.
“
Provider
”, “
We
”, “
Us
”, “
Our
” and “
Administrator
” mean Consumer Program Administrators, Inc., except in the state of California where
Provider
,
We
,
Us
,
Our
, and
Administrator
mean Motor Warranty Services of North America, California License #0E40891, all located at 175 West Jackson Blvd., Chicago, IL
60604, 1-800-594-8424.
“Agreement Price”
means the amount
You
paid for this Agreement shown on the Information Schedule.
“Purchase Date”
means the date
You
purchased this Agreement shown on the Information Schedule.
“Selling Store”
means the store from whom
You
purchased this Agreement shown on the Information Schedule.
“
Services
” mean oil change, oil filter, fluid top off, tire rotation and multi-point inspection.
“Term Months”
means the number of months for the Agreement Term shown on the Information Schedule.
“Vehicle”
means the vehicle shown on the Information Schedule.
“You”
and
“Your”
mean the Purchaser shown on the Information Schedule or an eligible person to whom this Agreement has been properly transferred
.
II. GUIDELINES
The total Number of Services purchased by
You will be provided during the Agreement Term in accordance with the Program Type indicated on the Information
Schedule.
Services
must be performed at Your Selling Store or any AutoNation Network
SM
store. For a complete listing of AutoNation Network
SM
stores, please go to
www.autonation.com/dealers.
Services can be performed at any time during the Agreement Term. The Selling Store recommends that You follow the maintenance s
chedule according
to Your Vehicle’s owner’s manual.
Subject to Your transfer rights in Section IV. GENERAL PROVISIONS below, Services
are available only to You and Your Vehicle.
AutoNation is partnering with RepairSmith to offer the option of convenient mobile Services.
Visit www.repairsmith.com/autonation to see if mobile Services are available in Your area.
Not available in all areas.
You will be responsible for the fee RepairSmith charges to travel to Your location. Any fee will be listed on the website: www.
repairsmith.com/autonation and
payable to RepairSmith. RepairSmith fees are not covered by this Agreement and are payable whether or not coverage is provided
under Your Agreement.
III. AGREEMENT LIMITATIONS
We will not pay for or cover the following:
•
Any Services not performed by the Selling Store, an AutoNation Network
SM
store or RepairSmith.
•
Any additional costs for maintenance work not specifically covered by this Agreement.
•
Any mechanical breakdown or failure of Your Vehicle
.
•
Any additional maintenance work that may be required or suggested by the manufacturer, Selling Store, an AutoNation Network
SM
store or RepairSmith.
•
Any maintenance or repair work required due to the continued operation and failure to protect Your Vehicle from further damage
caused by lack of necessary
coolant and/or lubricants.
•
Any engine oil other than the selected Program Type shown in the Agreement Information section of this Agreement.
IV. GENERAL PROVISIONS
1.
Agreement Term
The Agreement Term is the
Term Months
shown on the Information Schedule. This Agreement begins on the
Purchase Date
and expires when the total Number of
Services
purchased are redeemed or when the Expiration Date is reached, whichever occurs first.
2.
Dispute Resolution – Arbitration
This Agreement requires binding arbitration if there is an unresolved dispute between
You
and
Us
and/or the
Selling Store
concerning this Agreement
(including the
Cost
of, lack of or actual services covered by this Agreement). Under this Arbitration provision,
You
give up
Your
right to resolve any dispute
arising from this Agreement by a judge and/or a jury.
You
also agree not to participate as a class representative or class member in any class action litigation,
any class arbitration or any consolidation of individual arbitrations. Any dispute on the application of this arbitration provision will be made by the local court
of law in the county and state where
You
live. Notwithstanding this arbitration provision,
You
are not prohibited from bringing an action in Small Claims
Court to resolve
Your
dispute
.
The Consumer Arbitration Rules of the American Arbitration Association (
www.adr.org
) will apply to any arbitration under this Agreement.
To start
arbitration,
either
You
or
We
must make a written demand to the other party for arbitration.
You
may make written demand directly to
Us
at 175 West Jackson Blvd.,
Chicago, IL 60604, Attn: Law Department. This demand must be made within one year of the earlier of:
I.  The date the
damage
occurred or the date the dispute arose, or
II. The applicable statute of limitations period if that period is longer.
One mutually agreed upon arbitrator will be identified.
We
will advance to
You
all or part of the fees of the AAA and of the arbitrator.
The arbitrator may
otherwise allocate these fees.
Unless otherwise agreed to by
You
and
Us
, the arbitration will take place in the county and state in which
You
live. The
procedural rules for arbitration shall be governed by
the Federal Arbitration Act (9 U.S.C.A. § 1 et. seq.) and not by any state law concerning arbitration. The
laws of the state of Illinois (without giving effect to its conflict of law principles) govern all substantive matters arising out of or relating to this Agreement
and all transactions contemplated by this Agreement, including, without limitation, the validity, interpretation, construction, performance and enforcement of
this Agreement
. In the event either party files a claim(s) against the other, resulting in a ruling that a portion of this Agreement is unenforceable, the portion
of this Agreement that has been ruled to be unenforceable shall be severed, and the
remaining provisions shall be enforced. However, if the portion of the
Agreement that was ruled to be unenforceable is or includes the above waiver of class action rights, then this Agreement shall be unenforceable in its entirety.

3. How This Agreement May Be Transferred
Your
rights and duties under this Agreement may only be transferred to a subsequent purchaser of
Your Vehicle
directly by
You
within 30 days from the date of sale
to the subsequent owner. This Agreement may not be transferred to any entity in the business of selling or leasing motor vehic
les. In the event of
Your
death, the
benefits of this Agreement will be available to
Your
spouse or legal representative.
To transfer this Agreement,
You
must submit the following information to the
Administrator
:
•
Completed Transfer Request form, which can be obtained by contacting the
Administrator
;
•
Bill of Sale indicating date of sale of the
Vehicle
;
•
Copy of
Your
Agreement; and
•
$50 transfer fee made payable to the
Administrator
.
4. How This Agreement May Be Canceled
–
Including Refunds and Charges
Cancellation By You
You
may cancel this Agreement at any time and for any reason. To cancel, contact the
Selling Store
. The
Selling Store
will assist with
Your
cancellation request. If
You
are unable to return to the
Selling Store
,
You
must provide written notice to the
Administrator
. A copy of
Your
Agreement must be returned with
Your
request
for cancellation.
Cancellation By Us
We
may cancel this Agreement if there has been a material misrepresentation or fraud or
You
do not pay the
Agreement Price
.
Cancellation By Lienholder/Lessor
If this Agreement is financed or leased, the
Vehicle
Lienholder/Lessor may cancel this Agreement in the event
You
default in
Your
obligation to such Lienholder/
Lessor or in the event
Your
Vehicle
is declared a total loss or is repossessed.
How Refunds Are Calculated
If the Agreement is canceled within 60 days of the
Purchase Date
and
You
have not redeemed any
Services
, a 100% refund of the
Agreement Price
will be made.
After 60 days or if
You
have redeemed any
Services
, a pro-rata refund will be made based upon the lesser percentage of unused Number of
Services
or unused days
within the
Term Months
. The pro-rata refund will be calculated by multiplying the
Agreement Price
by the lesser percentage of: (a) the unused Number of
Services
divided by the total Number of
Services
purchased by
You
; or (b) the unused days within the
Term Months
divided by the total days within the
Term Months
of
Your
Agreement Term; less an administrative fee of $50. If this Agreement is canceled by
Us
, no administrative fee will be charged.
You
authorize that all refunds will be paid to the Lienholder/Lessor if any, otherwise the refund will be paid to
You
. If this Agreement is canceled by
You
or the
Lienholder, the refund, if any, will be paid or credited no more than 30 days from receipt of the cancellation notice by the
Selling Store
,
Administrator
or
Us
,
whichever occurs first. If this Agreement is canceled by
Us
, the refund, if any, will be paid or credited within 30 days of the date of cancellation.
5. Insurance
This Agreement is not an insurance contract. Our obligations under this Agreement are insured under an insurance policy issued
by Virginia Surety Company,
Inc., 175 West Jackson Blvd., Chicago, Illinois 60604. In the event We cease to operate, are bankrupt or Your covered Service i
s not paid within 60 days after
all required proof of loss has been filed, You may file a direct claim with Virginia Surety Company, Inc. To do so, please call
the following toll-free number
for instructions: 1-800-209-6206.
6. Entire Agreement
This Agreement represents the entire agreement between
You
and
Us
. No person has the authority to change this Agreement or to waive any of its provisions. No
other written or oral statement apply to this Agreement.
V. STATE AMENDMENTS
This Agreement is amended and the language below governs if
You
purchased the Agreement in a state listed below:
California
